headline: Findlay alone unbeaten while every rival has lost
dek: Findlay have won all three of their matches and conceded only twice. Every other programme in the conference has already been beaten, and Cedarville and Kentucky Wesleyan have yet to put a goal past anyone.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Findlay's six goals have come from five different scorers, and only two have gone in at the other end.

wire.line: Every side but Findlay has already been beaten, and Cedarville and Kentucky Wesleyan have yet to score.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Five matches have gone past their date with no published result. Kentucky Wesleyan account for most of them, and the site holds their opening defeat at Missouri-St. Louis and nothing else.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Thomas More have scored six, as many as Findlay, and lost twice while conceding four.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Pedro Costa has saved all eight shots he has faced for Walsh and is yet to concede.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Cedarville have drawn once and lost once without scoring a goal.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Leo Egerer has taken eleven shots for Findlay, scoring twice and setting up one more.

last_match.line: Findlay stay unbeaten; Indianapolis had already come away from Cedarville with a goalless draw.

next_match.line: Tiffin have followed a home defeat with a home win and have scored in both.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
